title: Sources in, video out
topic: How Emoton turns a pile of sources into a narrated, animated explainer video: the five stages, why the model fills a fixed storyboard instead of writing animation code, how a validator sends bad output back, how every claim cites its source, and the one timing rule that keeps the visuals in step with the voice.
audience: A developer who has used language models and wants output they can check, but has never seen how Emoton works.
rules: Only say what the sources say. Do not invent features, numbers or benchmarks.
Explain the pipeline with one diagram that builds up stage by stage and carries over between beats.
Show at least one storyboard primitive the way the schema defines it, for example a diagram's steps.
